closed_channels.why_closed: AI cited hair.com in 1 of your tested prompts on your category questions, and its 'best of' roundups read like independent editorial — but a competitor owns the site, and those roundups only ever feature the owner's own brands.
closed_channels.what_it_means: No pitch can win a citation here: the recommendation is the owner's marketing. Don't count it as a target you're failing to land — it is a closed door, and the category is the thing to win instead.
closed_channels.detail: Hair.com By L'Oreal is L'Oreal's own house media + storefront for its Professional Products portfolio (Redken, Kerastase, Matrix, Pureology, Mizani). Verified 2026-07-14 from its own page titles ('25 of the Best Hair Products from L'Oreal Pro Brands') and from the pages our audits cited (best-hair-oil.html, hair-oil-for-frizz.html): the roundups read editorial but only ever recommend L'Oreal-owned brands. Neither a neutral retailer nor a single brand — a corporate portfolio's owned media.
